claim: Coverage of the listings this search has captured. It is not a market census: a source counted here was searched, not exhausted, unless its sweep receipts reconcile.

standard.label: Gross rent
standard.why: Every cost comparison starts from the gross rent.

standard.label: Concession and lease term
standard.why: Free months without a term give no real net rent; renewals are priced on gross.

standard.label: Required monthly fees
standard.why: Amenity, utility and service charges move the true monthly cost; unknown is not zero.

standard.label: One-time move-in costs
standard.why: Application, move-in and board fees change the first-lease cost.

standard.label: Lease start date
standard.why: A unit that cannot start in the move-in window is not an option.

standard.label: Square footage
standard.why: Size is a heavily weighted dimension and unknown size scores as neutral.

standard.label: Floor plan of this unit
standard.why: Only the unit's own plan proves the layout, door and laundry closet.

standard.label: Enclosed bedroom
standard.why: Junior, flex and alcove layouts are often listed as one-bedrooms.

standard.label: Must-haves confirmed
standard.why: An unconfirmed must-have is an open gate, not a pass.

standard.label: Floor (stated, not guessed)
standard.why: Light, view and noise depend on the floor.

standard.label: Window direction
standard.why: Direct sun and view depend on which way the windows face.

standard.label: Photos or video of this unit
standard.why: Model and building photos do not show this unit's condition or view.

standard.label: Availability checked recently
standard.why: Listings go fast; an old check is not a fresh one.
